title: Updating the inner vertex
statement: For any counting-algorithm state $\sigma$ and natural number $z$, replacing coordinate $12$ of the register vector of $\sigma$ by $z$ gives the register vector of the state obtained by replacing its inner-vertex register $u$ by $z$.
replaced:
Let a state consist of seventeen natural-number registers, including an inner-vertex
register, and let its register vector list these coordinates in order, with the
inner-vertex register in coordinate $12$. For any state and any natural number $z$,
replacing coordinate $12$ of its register vector by $z$ gives the register vector of the
state obtained by setting its inner-vertex register to $z$.
